Dear Mr. Nakamura,

Thank you for your interest in our consulting services. [1] reviewing your company's recent financial reports, our team has identified several areas where we can add value.

We would like to schedule an initial consultation at your [2]. Please [3] us know your availability for the week of April 14th. We look forward to the [4] of working with you.

Best regards,
Sarah Collins

questions.explanation: 'After reviewing' — team reviewed first, then identified opportunities.
'At your convenience' is a standard polite business phrase.
'Look forward to the opportunity' is a standard closing.
